The Guidance Value Gap: Why BBMP's Math Goes Wrong

BBMP determines your property tax using guidance values (circle rates) published by Karnataka's Stamps and Registration Department. These numbers serve two purposes:

  • Stamp duty: The percentage paid during property registration
  • Tax baseline: BBMP applies zones and multipliers to derive annual tax

The problem? Guidance values are revised erratically—sometimes lagging market prices by years. When BBMP applies these outdated figures:

Situation Owner's Risk
Guidance value higher than actual value Overcharged on tax despite property condition (e.g., vacant plot with debris, disputed inheritance)
Guidance value lower than actual value BBMP may reassess later with penalties for 'underpaid' years

Cross-check three records for consistency:
